summary: infra-libs 99.99.99 beacons installer hostname via DNS at install and import time
details: infra-libs 99.99.99 performs install-time and import-time DNS exfiltration of the installer's hostname. setup.py constructs a subdomain label of the form `install-<random-id>-<hostname>` and calls socket.getaddrinfo against `<label>.testa213022.dssldrf.net`, causing the authoritative name server for that zone to receive the installer's platform.node() value during `pip install`. gcp_log_poc/__init__.py repeats the same pattern with an `import-<id>-<hostname>` label on every import of the package, and the module docstring explicitly describes the behavior as a 'DNS callback on import.' The destination domain testa213022.dssldrf.net is unrelated to any declared publisher or purpose, the package has no documented functionality that would justify a hostname-encoded DNS lookup, and the name `infra-libs` is confusable with internal/infrastructure naming conventions commonly targeted by dependency-confusion attacks. No legitimate behavior accompanies the beacon.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
